name: Dave DeSimone
biography: is the Manager of Information Security for a Fortune 1000 company. DeSimone has developed, implemented, and operationalized the global vulnerability management program for multiple distinct international organizations. DeSimone's expertise is in penetration testing, security event response, network security, vulnerability/malware analysis and security architecture. DeSimone has also developed major programs including risk management, penetration testing, and application security. Twitter: @d2theave
